verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own product page documents Agent Tasks as a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks: users can start new tasks, track progress, assign issues to Copilot, and iterate on the resulting pull requests from the phone. The community evidence predates this feature and does not address it. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the depth of mobile task management (e.g., stopping or steering running tasks, viewing logs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Agent Tasks mobile experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage and track cloud-based coding agent tasks from my phone

citations.quote: Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are. Easily start new tasks and keep track of progress while you’re on the move.
Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
the second phone screen displays a list of agent tasks
